title: Human Concurrence Record
description: Schema for human-concurrence records that gate governance-grade evidence packages from being emitted into nomination-grade artifacts. Lives at data-products/{target}/{indication}/{package_id}/concurrence.yaml. Iter-1 integrity primitive: git-signed-commit identity + CODEOWNERS-style reviewer registry. See plan § Evidence Card Framework § Human-concurrence checkpoint (A2) including the post-adversarial-review Integrity primitive subsection.

package_id.description: The evidence_package this record concurs with. Must match the package's package_id field exactly.

package_content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the evidence_package.json's deterministic fields, computed at concurrence time. If the package is later modified, this hash mismatches and verify_concurrence.py fails. This is the tamper-evidence primitive — without it, concurrence-after-mutation would be silently accepted.

reviewer_git_identity.description: The reviewer's verifiable git identity. NOT a self-typed reviewer_id field — these values are populated from the active git config at concurrence-CLI invocation time and verified against the signed commit that adds this record. See A2 § Integrity primitive: 'the reviewer's identity is not a self-typed reviewer_id field; it is the cryptographically-verified git committer of the commit that adds the concurrence.yaml.'

email.description: Git committer email (must match an entry in data-products/.concurrence-reviewers.yaml).

key_fingerprint.description: GPG or SSH key fingerprint used to sign the commit. Format depends on signing scheme; SHA-1 for SSH (40 hex chars) or SHA-256 (64 hex chars for newer GPG).

reviewer_role.description: Reviewer's authorized role per data-products/.concurrence-reviewers.yaml. Must match concurrence_state.enum.yaml's valid_reviewer_roles list. Iter-1 ships these three roles; iter-2 may add others.

concurrence_state.description: See concurrence_state.enum.yaml. The state field that downstream renderers consult to decide whether to emit the package into nomination-grade artifacts.

caveats_acknowledged.description: Reviewer's explicit caveats. Required (non-empty) when concurrence_state is concur_with_caveats or dissent; may be empty when concurrence_state is concur.

cards_individually_reviewed.description: Optional. Card_ids the reviewer inspected individually. Empty / omitted means the package was reviewed as a whole.

review_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the concurrence was recorded. Used for supersession ordering when a later concurrence record overrides this one.

supersedes.description: Optional. If this concurrence record supersedes a prior record (per concurrence_state.enum.yaml supersession semantics — 'a NEW concurrence record with a NEW commit; the most recent commit wins'), references the prior record's commit_sha.
